decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): On its own, the cited item [ev-d0c9247a44d4] is just one entry ("name") in a list. The surrounding section [ev-b07a4021f30c] explains what the list is. Loki 3.0 now adds a `service_name` label to every ingested log by default. It builds that label from the first matching label in an ordered list, and `name` is one entry in that default list ([ev-92063a2a5bac] through [ev-ea984d665a12]). The section also says who is affected and what happens: if no label matches, the value is `unknown_service`; Loki makes no new assignment if a `service_name` label already exists; and the list can be changed, or the feature turned off with an empty value, through `discover_service_name` in limits_config. So the subject is really the default `service_name` labelling (`discover_service_name` in limits_config), not a separate change called "name", and the section gives enough to write the typed assertion.
